title: California Insurance Code Section 530
claims: Insurance Code section 530 states that an insurer is liable for a loss of which a peril insured against was the proximate cause, although a peril not contemplated by the contract may have been a remote cause of the loss, but is not liable for a loss of which the peril insured against was only a remote cause.
updateCadence: Enacted by Stats. 1935, Ch. 145; verify current text at leginfo.
